name: Jaihind Synthetics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Jai hind Synthetics Ltd manufactures and sells textile products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a manufacturer, dealer, exporter, broker, agent, distributor, dyer, printer, bleacher of all textiles fibres, yarn, cloth, cotton, woollen, worsted stuff, silk, garments, handicrafts twisting, doubling, texturizing and crimping of polyester yarn silk, cotton, or blended yarn

cons: Stock is trading at 2.60 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -8.93%
Company has a low return on equity of 0.13% over last 3 years.
